_metadata.description: OT-P1-002 — per-plan velocity emitted as a signal, plus the plan supersession/dependency graph.

requirements.title: Track per-plan velocity and emit it to meta-optimization trials
requirements.description: Capture per-plan velocity (wall-time + tokens + iterations to complete; full vs partial) as a historical signal and emit it to meta-optimization-manager trials, so plan throughput becomes a measurable local-model-readiness input.

validation.notes: Completion captures local velocity and emits it through the velocity sink seam.

requirements.title: Maintain a plan supersession/dependency graph and per-surface templates
requirements.description: Track supersession/dependency edges between plans (using the stored content hash) and provide per-surface plan templates (CLI/proto/UI) so a new plan starts pre-scaffolded for its surface.

validation.notes: Matching content hashes derive supersession edges.
Dependency links are first-class graph edges.
Per-surface templates seed structured plan phases.
